title: Hamtaro - Ham-Ham Heartbreak
sources: own knowledge of the game (facts written for this def)
notes: Genre: Adventure. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Talk to Ham-Hams and use Ham-Chat words to fix the broken friendships Spat caused.
widgets.label: How it plays

widgets.text: A talk / use Ham-Chat, B cancel, Select: Ham-Chat dictionary
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text:
Ham-Chat words are actions Hamtaro can do (e.g. digging, sniffing, tackling).
Learn new ones from Ham-Hams and use them on the right object or hamster.
widgets.label: Words

widgets.text: Spat breaks up couples with his tricks; each chapter fixes one of them.
widgets.label: Spat

widgets.text: Ham-Ham Clubhouse, town streets, park, beach, the Ham-Ham bazaar and more as chapters open.
widgets.label: Places

widgets.text: Items received from Ham-Hams solve puzzles; sunflower seeds are the currency.
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text: 86 Ham-Chat words to collect (dictionary in the menu).
widgets.label: Dictionary

widgets.text: Repair every broken friendship and send Spat home.
widgets.label: Goal
